author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the past, when we write software, we have to write a document or user guide for the software seperately.

Now, when we build AI agents or skill, do we still have to write any document or user guide? Can I just tell the user ask GPT or Claude to teach you how to use my agent or my skill?
